note: USFS (Arapaho-Roosevelt NF, Canyon Lakes RD), run by a concessionaire; a small loop at ~8,440 ft between CO-14 and the Cache la Poudre, about 47 mi up the canyon from US-287, by the Big South Trailhead. --Claude
summary: FS page + map + ARP status table: confirmed 4 sites, vault toilet, no potable water, FCFS only, $23. Added max 30 ft from the page's 15-30 ft spurs (status table: 25 ft), season 05-22..09-20, booking note. The 'best suited for tent or small RV camping' wording is the FS page's own, not ARP boilerplate (flagged). Note trimmed.
flags: RIG-LENGTH WORDING (criteria check): the FS page singles Big South out - 'It is best suited for tent or small RV camping' - wording that does not appear on four other Canyon Lakes pages checked (Sleeping Elephant, Tom Bennett, Kelly Flats, Stove Prairie), so it is not boilerplate; the entry's note took it from there. The same page does state a length of 23 ft+: 'The parking length ranges from 15 to 30 feet', and the forest's status table gives Max Spur 25'. So by the agency's own figures a 23-ft rig fits only the longest of the four spurs, and the others (down to 15 ft) do not. Because a 23-ft+ length is stated, no review search was done; a human may still want one before sending EKKO to a 4-site campground where most spurs are short.
Max length conflict: FS page 15-30 ft vs status table Max Spur 25'. Recorded 30 (the campground page). Both are above 23 ft.
Website is only the ARP recreation index; replace it with the campground's page, https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/big-south-campground.
